VERDICT write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/serve.py, reckon/shell_assets.py, tests/test_the_shells_scripts_are_fetched_once.py, the evidence fragment, the figures dir); every path in the aae73199..3addd882 diff is inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, eight commits, the repair checkpoint names 707c4ebe and 3addd882, the head gates and the two negative controls with their EXIT= lines, and it records no baseline_suite/after_suite gate log.

JUSTIFICATION evidence: the head gate at review-route-head.log names revision 707c4ebe and ends "17 passed ... EXIT=0", but the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite log so the added-failure delta rests on the coordinator population arms rather than a base/head pair from this run.

SCORE fit: 18

SCORE reuse: 20
